messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearpay.com>, Tom Bingham <tom.b@clearpay.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@clearpay.com>

Subject: Post-demo: buying map + security scope kickoff for ClearPay

Hi Lena / Tom / Aisha — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned owners:  

Recap (2 min):
- Demo covered Redwood hosted API, Dedicated options, and Private VPC patterns.
- Focus areas you highlighted: predictable latency, audit logs, and encryption at rest for embeddings.

Who we think to loop in (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Tom Bingham (CFO) — confirm?
- Security reviewer: Aisha Khan — ok to start questionnaire intake with her team?
- Procurement: who owns MSA/POs? (Lena, can you confirm point person)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (reply here).
2) If OK, we will kick off a short security intake and share the questionnaire/Mutual Action Plan (MAP).
3) Proposed timeline: we can have initial answers back in 7–10 business days; let us know if you need an accelerated timeline.

Attached: post-demo deck (high level), will follow with the security intake form and MAP once you confirm contacts.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

— Ava
Ava Chen | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 15:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying map + security scope kickoff for ClearPay

Thanks Ava — great session. Confirming:  
- Economic buyer: Tom Bingham (CFO) — he will be the final sign-off for budget.
- Security reviewer: Aisha Khan (Infrastructure Security Lead) — she owns the questionnaire.
- Procurement: I own initial procurement coordination but procurement team will take over for MSA/terms.

Timeline and asks from our side:
- Aisha: please send the security questionnaire to my team and to procurement (procurement@clearpay.com).
- We typically request an SSO integration doc and a network diagram as part of initial scoping.
- Target: procurement aims to review vendor security packets within 10 business days; if Redwood can provide the intake + MAP this week, we can slot it.

Tom — quick note: if we like the answers on audit logs and encryption, procurement can prioritize the MSA.

Lena Ortiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships | ClearPay
lena.ortiz@clearpay.com

From: Kar thik Iyer <kar thik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying map + security scope kickoff for ClearPay

Ava — logging internal kickoff notes. Lena confirmed owners which is great. Suggested initial scope and responsibilities (internal):

Scope (proposed):
- Systems in scope: ClearPay webapp (prod + staging), ingestion/data pipeline for transactions, embeddings storage (S3), logging/observability stack, and SSO (Okta).
- Data types: PII limited to name/email and tokenized transaction metadata; no card PANs to be stored in embeddings.
- Access model: API keys per environment, token-level logs to be retained per SLO.

Who owns what (redwood):
- Kar thik: technical lead for intake, will coordinate network/security diagrams.
- Priyom: will own questionnaire responses and coordinate with runtime team for KV cache/prefix caching notes.
- Marissa: customer success / commercial liaison for MAP and timelines.

Open questions for ClearPay:
- Confirmation on retention period for logs and embeddings (30/90/365 days?).
- Do they require HSM/KMS integration with their KMS or can Redwood-managed keys be used initially?

I'll draft an intake bundle and the MAP, then Ava can send to Lena/Aisha/Tom.

-K
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearpay.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@clearpay.com>, Tom Bingham <tom.b@clearpay.com>
Cc: Kar thik Iyer <kar thik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying map + security scope kickoff for ClearPay

Thanks Lena — attaching the security intake form and a first-draft Mutual Action Plan for procurement. Key notes in the intake (high level):
- We marked the systems in-scope per Kar thik's bullets. Please flag any omissions.
- Retention: we suggested default 90 days for token logs and 365 days for audit logs; happy to adjust to your policy.
- Encryption: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS (we included a short KMS options matrix in the intake).

Attachments: redwood-security-intake-form.xlsx (fillable), redwood-mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf, network-diagram.png (sample topology).

Proposed next steps:
1) Aisha / Security team: review the intake and return initial answers or comments by EOD Wed 9/9 if possible.
2) Procurement (Lena): confirm preferred contract lead and PO process — we'll update MAP and scope accordingly.
3) Redwood: Kar thik and Priyom to be available for a 30-minute technical kickoff once intake is reviewed.

If a call helps, propose Tue 9/10 or Wed 9/11 morning PST — I'll coordinate depending on your availability.

— Ava

Attachment stubs: redwood-security-intake-form.xlsx (editable), redwood-mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (draft), network-diagram.png (700KB)
From: Tom Bingham <tom.b@clearpay.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearpay.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@clearpay.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying map + security scope kickoff for ClearPay

Thanks everyone — we appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement notes:  
- We will treat Redwood like a prioritized vendor if the intake shows encryption-at-rest and audit log fidelity meet our baseline.
- Target procurement timeline: internal review by 9/17, then final negotiations the week of 9/21.
- Immediate asks from procurement/security: a detailed network diagram (please include peering/IP ranges) and a short data-retention SOW (how long audit logs & embeddings are retained and deletion process).

Aisha — please coordinate the security review and we will flag any blockers. Ava / Kar thik / Priyom — can you confirm you can provide the network diagram and a 1-page retention SOW by 9/10? If yes, we will aim to get procurement sign-off on our side.

Thanks — Tom
CFO, ClearPay
